say:1:1720947001:1.text: Wait... what? The prince never drew the sword! So why is this written like it already happened?
say:1:1720947001:1.source_cn: 这……王子根本就没有拔剑啊！这上面写得怎么跟亲眼看见过一样？

say:3:1720947002:1.text: No, Haria, that's not the point. This is the real giveaway. Look at the note down here: "Get it on the front page as soon as they're back from the Hall of Ancients."
say:3:1720947002:1.source_cn: 不，赫蒂奇，你没看懂。这才是真正的大新闻……你看这行小...

say:4:1720947003:1.text: They wrote this ahead of time. It's not news! It's the story they want everyone to believe!
say:4:1720947003:1.source_cn: 这根本不是报道，而是提前准备好的宣传稿！或者说，是他们...

choice_prompt:5:1720947003.text: They wrote this ahead of time. It's not news! It's the story they want everyone to believe!
choice_prompt:5:1720947003.source_cn: 这根本不是报道，而是提前准备好的宣传稿！或者说，是他们希望发生的事实！

say:6:1720947004:1.text: So... all those stories smearing Princess Peggy were meant to...
say:6:1720947004:1.source_cn: 所以……《赛凡纳之眼》之前抹黑佩吉公主，就是为了……

say:7:1720947005:1.text: To pave the way for the prince, exactly! Bring the princess down, shove her out of the way, then stage a miracle and make it seem like the prince was fated to draw the sword. Once people believe that, the crown is as good as his!
say:7:1720947005:1.source_cn: 就是为了给王子的上位做铺垫！先把公主的名声搞臭，让她失...

say:8:1720947006:1.text: My gosh... these people are ruthless!
say:8:1720947006:1.source_cn: 天哪……贵族的世界，真是太可怕了！

choice:5:0:1.text: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 为奥利安王子的登基造势
choice:5:0:1.male: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.
choice:5:0:1.female: They're building a case for Prince Orion to take the throne.

choice:5:1:2.text: That's what this was all about.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 这才是他们的真实目的
choice:5:1:2.male: That's what this was all about.
choice:5:1:2.female: That's what this was all about.
